class simulator.ui.SatnogsPanel.SatNOGSPanel(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)#

Bases: QWidget

The main SatNOGSPanel class for showing two lists of SatNOGS stations, one for available stations and one of selected stations, allowing drag and drop between both lists. Station pictures are lazy-loaded for added context.
